# Projected inbox column WRITER baseline — membership only.
#
# One module path per line. Generated by
# `python -m scripts.architecture.inbox_projection_census --baseline`.
#
# Two-directional. A module that starts writing a column the composed
# inbox modules own fails the guard; so does a baselined module that
# stopped, until its line is deleted in the same change that routed it
# through `app/services/inbox_module/`.
#
# The target is ZERO, and an EMPTY baseline is part of the ADR-0013 P5
# activation gate: while a line remains, activating would let the
# reconciler overwrite a fact some other module still writes.
#
# The two intended writers — `app/services/inbox_writes.py` (the runtime
# seam) and `app/services/inbox_projection_reconciler.py` — are excluded
# by name and never appear here.
#
# What remains is blocked on FOUR named module gaps, not on effort.
# Each line below is one of them; see ADR-0013 § 6a.
#
# Late delivery outcome — `sent_at` / `external_message_id` are stamped
# after the provider accepts, but `record_message` takes the transport
# ref at admission because it feeds the dedup key:
#   app/services/communication_intents.py
#   app/services/team_inbox_outbound.py   (queue-then-update upsert)
#   app/tasks/notifications.py
#
# No external party — an internal channel has a Sub principal, not an
# address, and the module has no typed internal identity. Admitting
# them under an empty contact would make every anonymous session one
# shared thread:
#   app/services/team_inbox_field_job.py  (also needs provider thread
#     identity on an INTERNAL transport, which ChannelSpec forbids)
#   app/services/team_inbox_operations.py (internal note)

app/services/communication_intents.py
app/services/team_inbox_field_job.py
app/services/team_inbox_operations.py
app/services/team_inbox_outbound.py
app/tasks/notifications.py
